6:
Hustler House Rules1. You can challenge Hustlers
    once a day.2. All homies over Level 50 become
    Level 50 for the scrap.3. You can't use stuff from your Bag.4. After, your homies heal up
    and held items come back.5. You don't get experience from
    the scrap.6. You get Battle Points instead!Skilled Hustlers is invited to
join.
